file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

177	    std::map<const void*, Window>                        owned_;  // handed to callers, by address

199	    std::map<std::pair<std::vector<int64_t>, at::ScalarType>, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Staging>>> staging_;
200	};
201	
202	}  // namespace ulysses

"""The Python surface: a constructor, two collectives, and an output allocator.

Everything that survives a call -- the symmetric windows, the cached plans, the staging buffers --
lives in C++ (src/group.cc). What stays here is what has no C++ equivalent: the process group's
name, the comm stream, and ``AsyncCollectiveTensor``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import warnings

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
from torch.distributed._functional_collectives import AsyncCollectiveTensor

from . import _C


class CompletedHandle:
    """What the async call returns on a build whose libtorch has no ``c10d::register_work``. With
    no registry to bind the completion event to, the C++ side has already made the caller's stream
    wait on it, so ``wait()`` only unwraps -- a distinct type so that is visible."""

    def __init__(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> None:
        self._tensor = tensor

    def wait(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self._tensor

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"CompletedHandle({tuple(self._tensor.shape)}, {self._tensor.dtype})"


class UlyssesGroup:
    """Ulysses all-to-all over NVLink, moved by the copy engines.

    Construction is collective over ``process_group``. Windows are allocated on the first call that
    needs one and cached, so every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes. Contract:
    docs/api.md.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        process_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None = None,
        device: torch.device | str | int | None = None,
        *,
        require_nvlink: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Args:
            process_group: the group this collective runs over; ``None`` uses ``dist.group.WORLD``.
            device: this rank's CUDA device, as anything ``torch.device`` accepts; ``None`` and a
                device with no index both use the current device.
            require_nvlink: refuse a group whose GPUs are not all NVLink-joined. ``False`` is for
                measuring that case, not for running in it.
        """
        # Before anything that can throw: a refused construction -- a non-NVLink group, a device
        # that is not CUDA -- still leaves an object for __del__ to run on, with nothing to
        # release.
        self._destroyed = True
        pg = process_group if process_group is not None else dist.group.WORLD
        self.pg = pg
        self.rank = dist.get_rank(pg)
        self.world_size = dist.get_world_size(pg)
        # Normalised, because everything below indexes `device.index`: a bare "cuda:0" string has
        # no .index attribute, and torch.device("cuda") has one that is None. Both used to fail
        # several lines later, on a message about neither the device nor this constructor.
        device = torch.device("cuda" if device is None else device)
        if device.type != "cuda":
            raise ValueError(f"device must be a CUDA device, got {device}")
        if device.index is None:
            device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
        self.device = device
        torch.cuda.set_device(device)

        if require_nvlink:
            self._require_nvlink()

        # Registers the group with torch's symmetric-memory bootstrap, which rendezvous needs. It
        # is idempotent, and deprecated from torch 2.13 (where rendezvous resolves the group by
        # itself) -- calling it anyway is what keeps 2.10 working.
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", FutureWarning)
            symm_mem.enable_symm_mem_for_group(pg.group_name)

        self._handle = torch.classes.fast_ulysses.UlyssesGroup(
            pg.group_name, int(self.rank), int(self.world_size), int(device.index)
        )

        # High-priority stream for the async call only; the sync call stays on the caller's stream,
        # since routing it through here costs two event hops. The two streams are NOT ordered
        # against each other, which is why the C++ side gives them separate windows.
        _, greatest = torch.cuda.Stream.priority_range()
        self._comm_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device, priority=greatest)
        self._destroyed = False

    def _require_nvlink(self) -> None:
        """Every rank checks the same set of devices, so the answer is identical on all of them and
        the refusal is collective in practice."""
        local = torch.tensor([self.device.index], dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
        gathered = [torch.zeros_like(local) for _ in range(self.world_size)]
        dist.all_gather(gathered, local, group=self.pg)
        devices = [int(t.item()) for t in gathered]
        if len(set(devices)) != len(devices):
            return  # more than one rank per GPU: not a topology this check is about
        problem = _C.check_nvlink(devices)
        if problem:
            raise RuntimeError(problem)

    def all_to_all_4d(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """mode 0 scatters heads and gathers sequence; mode 1 inverts it.

        Returns a tensor the caller owns, with no lifetime rules. ``out`` from ``empty_output()``
        skips the copy-out; any other contiguous CUDA tensor of the output shape is copied into.

        ``seq_splits[p]`` / ``head_splits[p]`` are rank p's sequence and head shard: pass both or
        neither, identical on every rank and matching the shape handed in. Neither means even
        shards. Collective: every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes.
        """
        if out is None:
            return torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d(
                self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits
            )
        # Refused rather than silently wrong, for the same reason the async call refuses: the
        # out-variant mutates a buffer the caller already owns, so it carries no autograd formula
        # and what comes back is that buffer -- backward() would run to completion and leave
        # x.grad as None. The returned value cannot signal it either, since nothing distinguishes
        # a caller who wanted no gradient from one whose gradient was dropped.
        if torch.is_grad_enabled() and x.requires_grad:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "all_to_all_4d(out=...) does not support autograd: the out-variant is a mutating "
                "op with no backward, so the gradient would be dropped without an error. Drop "
                "out=, or run under torch.no_grad()."
            )
        # Two ops, one method: the out-variant declares the alias it really has, which is what
        # keeps the functional one differentiable. See the note in src/bindings.cc.
        torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_out(
            self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits, out
        )
        return out

    def all_to_all_4d_async(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        lend: bool = False,
    ) -> torch.Tensor | CompletedHandle:
        """``all_to_all_4d`` on this group's comm stream, returning immediately.

        The result is an ``AsyncCollectiveTensor``: ``.wait()`` returns the plain tensor, and so
        does the first use by any aten op -- either way the caller's stream waits on the comm
        stream's completion event GPU-side, and the host does not block. A view op re-wraps without
        waiting.

        ``lend=True`` gets ``out=``'s saving without a buffer of your own: the peers write a window
        this group holds, the result IS that window, and there is no copy-out. The group rotates
        through four windows per dtype, so at most four lent results may be alive at once -- a
        fifth call raises rather than overwriting one, and the count is per rank, so every rank has
        to drop its results at the same point in its own program. Mutually exclusive with ``out=``.
        Like the rest of this method it is not differentiable.

        Wait on, or use, every result: a dropped one leaves its entry in torch's work registry, and
        ``out=`` is the hole, since reading your own ``out`` never touches the registry. On a
        libtorch with no ``c10d::register_work`` this returns a ``CompletedHandle`` instead --
        correct, no overlap, and a distinct type so it is visible.
        """
        # Refused rather than silently ignored: both ask for the zero-copy path, and picking one
        # for the caller would leave a lend=True that quietly did nothing.
        if out is not None and lend:
            raise ValueError(
                "all_to_all_4d_async takes out= or lend=True, not both: each is a way of getting "
                "the zero-copy path, one with a buffer you own and one with a window the group "
                "lends. Drop whichever you did not mean."
            )
        # Refused rather than silently wrong. AsyncCollectiveTensor is built with
        # _make_wrapper_subclass(..., requires_grad=elem.requires_grad), which makes the wrapper a
        # LEAF: autograd runs above the subclass and never sees the wrapped tensor's history, so
        # backward() would deposit the gradient on the wrapper and leave x.grad as None.
        if torch.is_grad_enabled() and x.requires_grad:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "all_to_all_4d_async does not support autograd: its result is an "
                "AsyncCollectiveTensor, which is a leaf, so the gradient would be dropped without "
                "an error. Use all_to_all_4d()."
            )
        # This group's device, not the current one: an aten op on `x` runs on the current stream
        # of x's device whatever device is current, and that stream is what the transfer has to be
        # ordered against. With another device current, the no-argument form names a stream on it,
        # which orders nothing here and cannot take record_stream() for this tensor.
        caller = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
        with torch.cuda.stream(self._comm_stream):
            if out is None:
                y = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_staged(
                    self._handle,
                    x,
                    mode,
                    seq_splits,
                    head_splits,
                    caller.stream_id,
                    caller.device_index,
                    lend,
                )
            else:
                torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_staged_out(
                    self._handle,
                    x,
                    mode,
                    seq_splits,
                    head_splits,
                    out,
                    caller.stream_id,
                    caller.device_index,
                )
                y = out
        registered = _C.register_stream_completion(y, self._comm_stream.cuda_stream)
        # Two streams touch the output: one allocated it, the other wrote it, and the caching
        # allocator must know about the cross-stream use before it may recycle the block.
        y.record_stream(self._comm_stream)
        y.record_stream(caller)
        return AsyncCollectiveTensor(y) if registered else CompletedHandle(y)

    def empty_output(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """A buffer shaped like ``all_to_all_4d(x, mode=...)``'s output, in symmetric memory.

        Passing it back as ``out=`` makes the peers write it directly, which removes the copy-out.
        You own it: keep it across steps, free it when you like, and it may outlive the group.
        COLLECTIVE, so allocate outside the loop -- and use one buffer per concurrent call, since a
        call overwrites it.
        """
        return torch.ops.fast_ulysses.empty_output(self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits)

    def _timed(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, float]]:
        """BENCHMARKS ONLY: the copying call with CUDA events between its stages, which sum to the
        whole call because they are strictly ordered on one stream. Reading the events syncs."""
        out, stages = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_timed(
            self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits
        )
        names = ("barrier_in", "transfer", "barrier_out", "copy_out")
        return out, dict(zip(names, (float(v) for v in stages), strict=True))

    def destroy(self) -> None:
        """Release the group's windows and its transfer stream. Collective: dropping a window is.
        Buffers from ``empty_output()`` are unaffected -- they are yours."""
        if self._destroyed:
            return
        # Drain the comm stream first: dist.barrier only syncs the caller's current stream, so an
        # unwaited async call could still be writing a window that is about to be freed.
        self._comm_stream.synchronize()
        dist.barrier(group=self.pg)
        self._handle.destroy()
        self._destroyed = True

    def __del__(self) -> None:
        # A group that is dropped rather than destroyed still has to outlive its own transfers.
        # The handle's C++ destructor waits on the internal transfer stream but knows nothing of
        # this one, so an unwaited async call could still be writing a window as it is freed.
        # There is no barrier here on purpose: a finalizer is no place for a collective, which is
        # why destroy() and not this is the supported path.
        if not self._destroyed:
            self._comm_stream.synchronize()

1	"""The Python surface: a constructor, two collectives, and an output allocator.
2	
3	Everything that survives a call -- the symmetric windows, the cached plans, the staging buffers --
4	lives in C++ (src/group.cc). What stays here is what has no C++ equivalent: the process group's
5	name, the comm stream, and ``AsyncCollectiveTensor``.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import warnings
11	
12	import torch
13	import torch.distributed as dist
14	import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
15	from torch.distributed._functional_collectives import AsyncCollectiveTensor
16	
17	from . import _C
18	
19	
20	class CompletedHandle:
21	    """What the async call returns on a build whose libtorch has no ``c10d::register_work``. With
22	    no registry to bind the completion event to, the C++ side has already made the caller's stream
23	    wait on it, so ``wait()`` only unwraps -- a distinct type so that is visible."""
24	
25	    def __init__(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> None:
26	        self._tensor = tensor
27	
28	    def wait(self) -> torch.Tensor:
29	        return self._tensor
30	
31	    def __repr__(self) -> str:
32	        return f"CompletedHandle({tuple(self._tensor.shape)}, {self._tensor.dtype})"
33	
34	
35	class UlyssesGroup:
36	    """Ulysses all-to-all over NVLink, moved by the copy engines.
37	
38	    Construction is collective over ``process_group``. Windows are allocated on the first call that
39	    needs one and cached, so every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes. Contract:
40	    docs/api.md.
41	    """
42	
43	    def __init__(
44	        self,
45	        process_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None = None,
46	        device: torch.device | str | int | None = None,
47	        *,
48	        require_nvlink: bool = True,
49	    ) -> None:
50	        """
51	        Args:
52	            process_group: the group this collective runs over; ``None`` uses ``dist.group.WORLD``.
53	            device: this rank's CUDA device, as anything ``torch.device`` accepts; ``None`` and a
54	                device with no index both use the current device.
55	            require_nvlink: refuse a group whose GPUs are not all NVLink-joined. ``False`` is for
56	                measuring that case, not for running in it.
57	        """
58	        # Before anything that can throw: a refused construction -- a non-NVLink group, a device
59	        # that is not CUDA -- still leaves an object for __del__ to run on, with nothing to
60	        # release.
61	        self._destroyed = True
62	        pg = process_group if process_group is not None else dist.group.WORLD
63	        self.pg = pg
64	        self.rank = dist.get_rank(pg)
65	        self.world_size = dist.get_world_size(pg)
66	        # Normalised, because everything below indexes `device.index`: a bare "cuda:0" string has
67	        # no .index attribute, and torch.device("cuda") has one that is None. Both used to fail
68	        # several lines later, on a message about neither the device nor this constructor.
69	        device = torch.device("cuda" if device is None else device)
70	        if device.type != "cuda":
71	            raise ValueError(f"device must be a CUDA device, got {device}")
72	        if device.index is None:
73	            device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
74	        self.device = device
75	        torch.cuda.set_device(device)
76	
77	        if require_nvlink:
78	            self._require_nvlink()
79	
80	        # Registers the group with torch's symmetric-memory bootstrap, which rendezvous needs. It
81	        # is idempotent, and deprecated from torch 2.13 (where rendezvous resolves the group by
82	        # itself) -- calling it anyway is what keeps 2.10 working.
83	        with warnings.catch_warnings():
84	            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", FutureWarning)
85	            symm_mem.enable_symm_mem_for_group(pg.group_name)
86	
87	        self._handle = torch.classes.fast_ulysses.UlyssesGroup(
88	            pg.group_name, int(self.rank), int(self.world_size), int(device.index)
89	        )
90	
91	        # High-priority stream for the async call only; the sync call stays on the caller's stream,
92	        # since routing it through here costs two event hops. The two streams are NOT ordered
93	        # against each other, which is why the C++ side gives them separate windows.
94	        _, greatest = torch.cuda.Stream.priority_range()
95	        self._comm_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device, priority=greatest)
96	        self._destroyed = False
97	
98	    def _require_nvlink(self) -> None:
99	        """Every rank checks the same set of devices, so the answer is identical on all of them and
100	        the refusal is collective in practice."""
101	        local = torch.tensor([self.device.index], dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
102	        gathered = [torch.zeros_like(local) for _ in range(self.world_size)]
103	        dist.all_gather(gathered, local, group=self.pg)
104	        devices = [int(t.item()) for t in gathered]
105	        if len(set(devices)) != len(devices):
106	            return  # more than one rank per GPU: not a topology this check is about
107	        problem = _C.check_nvlink(devices)
108	        if problem:
109	            raise RuntimeError(problem)
110	
111	    def all_to_all_4d(
112	        self,
113	        x: torch.Tensor,
114	        *,
115	        mode: int = 0,
116	        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
117	        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
118	        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
119	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
120	        """mode 0 scatters heads and gathers sequence; mode 1 inverts it.
121	
122	        Returns a tensor the caller owns, with no lifetime rules. ``out`` from ``empty_output()``
123	        skips the copy-out; any other contiguous CUDA tensor of the output shape is copied into.
124	
125	        ``seq_splits[p]`` / ``head_splits[p]`` are rank p's sequence and head shard: pass both or
126	        neither, identical on every rank and matching the shape handed in. Neither means even
127	        shards. Collective: every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes.
128	        """
129	        if out is None:
130	            return torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d(
131	                self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits
132	            )
133	        # Refused rather than silently wrong, for the same reason the async call refuses: the
134	        # out-variant mutates a buffer the caller already owns, so it carries no autograd formula
135	        # and what comes back is that buffer -- backward() would run to completion and leave
136	        # x.grad as None. The returned value cannot signal it either, since nothing distinguishes
137	        # a caller who wanted no gradient from one whose gradient was dropped.
138	        if torch.is_grad_enabled() and x.requires_grad:
139	            raise RuntimeError(
140	                "all_to_all_4d(out=...) does not support autograd: the out-variant is a mutating "
141	                "op with no backward, so the gradient would be dropped without an error. Drop "
142	                "out=, or run under torch.no_grad()."
143	            )
144	        # Two ops, one method: the out-variant declares the alias it really has, which is what

Measured 2026-08-08, H100 on 2026-08-09. All five GPU models are in.
Read the H100 caveat in "Machines": its two samples are the same node, so its spread is run-to-run
variance and not the node-to-node agreement the other four report.

Every number here is 0.2.0's, and it still describes the transfer path, which 0.2.1 did not touch.
What 0.2.1 added sits above that path and is **not measured**: the staging pool, which lets
same-shaped async calls overlap rather than serialise on the caller's stream, and `lend=True`,
which drops the copy-out without a caller-owned buffer. Both are correctness-tested and neither
has a number, because the method below needs a whole idle node and none was available.

## Method

Every number is taken under `tools/exclusive.sh`, which refuses to start until the requested GPUs
are free, samples throughout, and prints `EXCLUSIVE` or `CONTENDED`. Every run below reported
`EXCLUSIVE`. Numbers from different machines are not compared except where the table says so.

- **Whole node, 8 GPUs**, allocated exclusively, behind a GPU health gate.
- **One binary.** A single wheel built for `80;90;100;120` was installed on every machine

# 暂存池：stage 与 release_staged

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u7-l1）我们看到 `all_to_all_4d_async` 把整段「屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out」流水线搬上组级 comm 流，与 caller 流上的计算重叠。但那里有一个被一笔带过的关键步骤：**输入在进入 comm 流之前，先被拷进了一块由 group 持有的暂存（staging）缓冲**。本讲回答三个问题：

1. 为什么输入必须先拷一份？直接让 comm 流读调用者的张量行不行？（答案：行，但代价是跨流生命周期问题——要么内存不安全，要么用 `record_stream` 把每个已释放的输入都钉到 comm 流追上为止。）
2. 暂存缓冲为什么是**按 (shape, dtype) 键的池**，每形状至多 4 槽、全局至多 16 个形状？第 5 个同形状并发调用会发生什么？
3. 释放事件（release event）为什么由一个 `noexcept` 函数记录，而且**在传输抛异常时也必须记录**？

学完本讲，你应该能独立读通 `stage()` 与 `release_staging()` 的每一个分支，并设计出验证池行为的测试。

## 2. 前置知识

- **caller 流与 comm 流**：u7-l1 已建立的两条互不排序的 CUDA 流。caller 流是用户代码当前所在的流（输入张量在这里产生、也在这里被读）；comm 流是 group 在构造时创建的最高优先级流（[python/fast_ulysses/group.py:94-95](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L94-L95)），异步交换全在这里执行。
- **CUDA 缓存分配器与 `record_stream`**：torch 的 GPU 内存不是每个 `free` 都真正还给驱动，而是回到 per-stream 的缓存池，**在同一条流上**复用。若一个张量在 A 流分配、又被 B 流使用，就必须调 `Tensor.record_stream(B)`，告诉分配器「B 还在用这块内存，A 流上释放后别急着复用」。代价：这块内存会被一直钉住，直到 B 流推进到登记点之后。本讲的核心权衡正是「对每个输入张量做 `record_stream`」与「拷进一小池 group 自己的缓冲」之间的选择。
- **CUDA 事件的三个操作**：`cudaEventRecord(ev, stream)` 在流的当前位置插一个完成标记；`cudaEventQuery(ev)` 立即返回 `cudaSuccess`（已触发）或 `cudaErrorNotReady`（尚未触发），不阻塞；`cudaStreamWaitEvent(s, ev, 0)` 让流 s 在 ev 触发前不再前进，也是 GPU 侧的等待、不阻塞主机。一个从未被 record 过的事件，query 会返回 `cudaSuccess`——这在后文的扫描逻辑里正好是「从未被读过」的正确答案。
- **InferenceMode（推理模式）**：`torch.inference_mode()` 下创建的张量叫**推理张量**，它不记录版本计数器，且这个身份是**永久的**——之后在推理模式之外向它做 `copy_` 会直接 raise。这是 C++ 侧一个容易踩的坑，本讲会看到 `stage()` 如何显式绕开。
- **scope guard（作用域守卫）**：一个析构函数里做清理工作的栈对象。C++ 的栈对象在离开作用域时析构，**即使是因为异常展开（exception unwinding）离开**——这是「异常路径也要释放」的标准手段。
- 承接 u6-l2 的纪律：**一切可能抛错的检查先于第一个屏障**。本讲会看到它在异步路径上的又一处应用（检查先于 `stage()`）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

注意一个分层事实：**staging 缓冲不是对称内存**。对称内存（u4 系列讲的窗口）是 peers 直写的输出通道；staging 只是普通 `at::empty` 分配的**输入副本**，从不上跨进程——它是纯粹的流间隔离装置。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 stage 拷贝与事件：为什么输入必须先拷一份

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

设想不拷贝：`all_to_all_4d_async(x)` 直接把 `x.data_ptr()` 交给 comm 流上的 CE 拷贝。有两个问题。

**问题一（内存安全）**：`x` 是 caller 流上的张量。Python 侧 `all_to_all_4d_async` 返回后，用户可能立刻让 `x` 离开作用域——分配器看到 caller 流上已无引用，就把这块内存放回缓存池，**在同一条 caller 流上**复用。而 comm 流上的交换可能还没开始读它。两条流互不排序，复用写入与交换读取就会竞争。

**问题二（`record_stream` 的代价）**：正统修法是对 `x` 调 `record_stream(comm)`——分配器从此不敢复用这块内存，直到 comm 流推进过登记点。安全了，但**每个**异步输入都被钉住一段不可控的时间；对推理循环里每步一批新输入的形态，钉住的内存量随发行节奏累积。源码注释原话：「record_stream would instead pin every freed input until the comm stream caught up」（[src/bindings.cc:389-392](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L389-L392)）。

`stage()` 选第三条路：**在 caller 流上**把 `x` 拷进一块 group 自己持有、永不提前释放的缓冲；comm 流从头到尾只看这块副本。caller 的张量只被 caller 流读，comm 的读取对象生命周期由 group 管理。一次拷贝换来两条流之间唯一的耦合点——两个事件。

附带一个红利：这个拷贝**顺便吸收了非连续输入**。`run_staged` 刻意不调 `contiguous()`——那会把重排拷贝发射到 comm 流上，恰恰变成一次「没人排序过的跨流读取」；`stage()` 里的 `copy_` 在 caller 流上做同样的事，且时序正确。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次异步调用中，staging 相关的时序（`ready` 是每次调用新建的事件；`release` 是随槽位存活的事件）：

```text
caller 流:  ... 生产 x ...
            slot->tensor.copy_(x)          ← stage() 发起的暂存拷贝
            cudaEventRecord(ready, caller)
comm  流:   cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready)   ← 副本就绪前不开读
            开路屏障 → CE 传输（读 slot->tensor）→ 收尾屏障 → copy_out
            cudaEventRecord(slot->release, comm)  ← release_staging() 记录：
                                                    comm 已读完，槽可复用
（之后某次同形状调用）
caller 流:  cudaEventQuery(slot->release) == cudaSuccess ?
            → 是：直接复用该槽          ← 零成本路径
```

两个事件各管一个方向：`ready` 让 **comm 等 caller**（副本写完才能读）；`release` 让 **caller 等 comm**（comm 读完才能覆写）。二者合起来把「一条流上的写入」安全地移交给「另一条流上的读取」，再把缓冲安全地拿回来。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看唯一调用方 `run_staged`，确认 stage 落在哪一步之前：

[src/bindings.cc:374-395](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L374-L395)：`run_staged` 的主体。按顺序：`check_alive` / `require_cuda` / `require_group_device` 三个检查**先于** `stage()`——注释给出两个理由：destroy 之后再建的 staging 条目永远不会被清理、事件随 group 泄漏；而且暂存缓冲按 (shape, dtype) 缓存却取**输入的设备**，一次错设备的调用会在错误设备上留下缓冲。随后 `comm = getCurrentCUDAStream()`（Python 已把 comm 流设为当前流），再从两个整数重建 caller 流（u7-l1 讲过的 `Stream::unpack3`），最后 `stage(input, caller, comm)`，返回的 `slot->tensor` 作为传输输入传给 `run()`。

stage 的拷贝与 ready 事件本体在 `stage()` 尾部：

[src/group.cc:340-401](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L340-L401)：`const c10::cuda::CUDAStreamGuard guard(caller);` 之后的一切都发生在 **caller 的流**上——注释明确写着「caller 的张量只在这里被读，comm 流只看到暂存副本」。尾部三行是本模块的核心：

```cpp
slot->tensor.copy_(x);                        // 暂存拷贝，caller 流
const Event ready(cudaEventDisableTiming);    // 每次调用新建，RAII 托管
ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(ready, caller));
ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready, 0));
```

注意 ready 事件「trailing everything already submitted on the caller's stream—including any earlier consumer of this same buffer」：它排在 caller 流当前尾部，所以连**同槽上一位读者的残留工作**也被一并覆盖进等待里。

`Event` 是 [include/fast_ulysses/common.hpp:33-57](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/common.hpp#L33-L57) 的 RAII 包装，在 `stage()` 返回时析构。此时它已被 record 且 comm 已挂上等待；CUDA 对「已完成记录、尚有等待挂着」的事件的销毁是延迟到引用全部完成的，所以提前销毁句柄是安全的——这也是作者用手写 `cudaEventCreateWithFlags`/`cudaEventDestroy` 配对换成 RAII 的原因之一（见该类注释：手工配对在抛异常的调用上每次泄漏一个事件）。

最后看非连续输入的实测：[test/distributed/correctness.py:167-177](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/distributed/correctness.py#L167-L177)：构造一个 `wide[..., :128]` 的跨步张量，断言它确实非连续（「built a contiguous tensor; it tests nothing」——测试自己的负控制），然后验证 async 结果与 sync 参照位精确一致。这个用例存在的原因就是 4.1.1 说的「暂存拷贝吸收跨步读取」。

2. 在纸上画两条流的时间轴，标注：`copy_`、`ready` 的 record 与 wait、开路屏障、CE 传输、收尾屏障、`release` 的 record。标出「comm 流读 slot->tensor」的区间被哪两个事件夹住。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果把 `cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready, 0)` 这一行删掉，最坏会发生什么？

**答案**：comm 流不再等暂存拷贝完成。CE 拷贝可能在 `copy_` 写入之前或进行中读取 `slot->tensor`，读到旧数据或半新半旧的数据——静默的数据错误，不报错。特别是复用槽位时（4.2），旧一轮数据还在，错误结果看起来完全合法。

**练习 2**：ready 事件为什么每次调用新建（RAII），而 release 事件随槽位常驻？

**答案**：ready 的语义是「caller 流**当前尾部**已到」——每次调用尾部不同，事件必须新鲜；用完即弃，交给 RAII 最省事。release 的语义是「comm 流已读完**这个槽**」——它描述的是槽位状态而非某次调用，要与槽同生命周期，供后续所有同形状调用 query。

### 4.2 按 (shape, dtype) 的池：结构、扫描复用与 16 形状上限

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

有了单个暂存缓冲，最朴素的实现是「一个 shape 一个槽」。但头文件注释点出要害（[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:121-126](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L121-L126)）：**共享一个槽仍然是正确的，只是不并发**——第二个调用的暂存拷贝会在 caller 流上等第一个交换退休，把「提前发行以重叠的计算」重新串行化。池存在的理由是**并发**而非正确性：把一次打包交换拆成 q/k/v 三次同形状异步调用时（这正是 lend 轮转选 4 的同一动机），三次应当同时在天上。

于是结构是：`staging_` 是一个 map，键 `(shape 向量, dtype)`，值是**槽位池**（`unique_ptr<Staging>` 的向量）。选择逻辑三档（详见 4.3 的分支图）：扫到一个 comm 流已读完的槽就复用；没有且未到上限就新建；没有且到上限就等待。

两个结构性细节值得先记：

- **`unique_ptr` 而非值存储**：调用方（`run_staged`）在整段传输期间持有裸 `Staging*`；若向量按值存 `Staging`，`push_back` 扩容会搬移对象、使已发出去的指针悬空。`unique_ptr` 保证指向的对象永不动。
- **16 形状上限**：与 `plans_` 的 512 条上限同一动机（防数据依赖形状无限增长），但这里每个条目钉着**真金白银的显存**（每形状最多 4 个整输入大小的缓冲），所以界更紧。超界时的动作是「全清」：先 `cudaEventSynchronize` 每个槽的 release 事件（**主机阻塞**，等 comm 流确实读完），销毁事件，然后 `staging_.clear()`。注释解释了为什么此时同步是安全的：`release_staging()` 在 `run_staged` 的 scope guard 里已经对**每个**已发行调用执行过，同步等到的必然是已记录的事件。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
stage(x, caller, comm):
  key = (x.shape, x.dtype)
  若 staging_ 已有 16 个形状且 key 不在其中:
      对每个槽: cudaEventSynchronize(release); cudaEventDestroy(release)   # 主机阻塞
      staging_.clear()                                # 全清，下次调用重建
  pool = staging_[key]

  CUDAStreamGuard(caller)                              # 以下全在 caller 流

  slot = null
  for candidate in pool:                               # 第一档：扫描复用
      if cudaEventQuery(candidate->release) == cudaSuccess:
          slot = candidate; break                      # comm 已读完，白拿
      （NotReady 落进 sticky last error，需 cudaGetLastError() 清掉）

  if slot == null and pool.size() < 4:                 # 第二档：新建（见 4.3）
      ...
  elif slot == null:                                   # 第三档：池满等待（见 4.3）
      ...

  slot->tensor.copy_(x)                                # caller 流
  record(ready, caller); wait(comm, ready)             # comm 等副本
  return slot
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

池的声明与注释：[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:197-199](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L197-L199)——`std::map<std::pair<std::vector<int64_t>, at::ScalarType>, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Staging>>> staging_;`，注释即「unique_ptr 因为调用方跨传输持有 `Staging*`，池增长不得搬移已发出去的槽」。

键与 16 形状上限：[src/group.cc:322-338](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L322-L338)。这段的注释把与 `plans_` 的差别讲得很清楚：「Unlike plans_, every entry here pins up to kMaxStagingPerShape inputs' worth of device memory, so the bound matters more」——plan 缓存超界清空的代价是每形状几微秒的重算，这里超界清空的代价是每个存活形状多付一次拷贝。

扫描循环：[src/group.cc:347-361](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L347-L361)：

```cpp
for (auto& candidate : pool) {
    const cudaError_t status = cudaEventQuery(candidate->release);
    if (status == cudaSuccess) { slot = candidate.get(); break; }
    if (status != cudaErrorNotReady) { ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(status); }
    (void)cudaGetLastError();
}
```

三处细节：`cudaSuccess` 即「comm 已读完（或从未记录过——从未被读，同样是空闲的正确答案）」；真正的错误码仍走检查宏抛出；而 `cudaErrorNotReady` 虽是本次调用的正常答案，却会落进 CUDA 的 sticky last error，被下一个不相关的 `cudaGetLastError()` 当成自己的错报出来——所以当场清掉，注释说这与 `at::cuda::CUDAEvent::query()` 的做法同源。

### 4.3 kMaxStagingPerShape：每形状 4 槽上限、池满等待与新建槽的三个细节

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

常量在 [include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:191-195](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L191-L195)：`static constexpr size_t kMaxStagingPerShape = 4;`。选 4 的理由写在注释里：一次打包交换拆成 q/k/v 后还有余量；而**每个槽都钉着一份完整输入的显存**，过了界就让调用等待而不是无限增长——所以 16 形状的总账是 16 × 4 = 64 个输入大小的缓冲，显存开销有硬上界。

第 5 个并发调用走「池满等待」档：挑 `pool.front()`，在 **caller 流**上 `cudaStreamWaitEvent(caller, slot->release, 0)`。两个微妙点：

- 等待插在 caller 流上，意味着这次调用的暂存拷贝 `copy_` 被推迟到 comm 流读完 front 槽——阻塞是 GPU 侧的、且阻塞的是**发起调用这条流**，不是主机。这与头文件注释「the second call's copy waits, ON THE CALLER'S STREAM」精确对应：等待的位置本身就是损失（caller 流被拖住），但方向正确（不能让 comm 流等 caller 的拷贝，那会反噬所有在途交换）。
- 挑 `front()` 而非「最先退休的槽」：注释承认 front 是「第一个**建成**的槽，不是第一个会退休的」——扫描从它开始，所以它反而最常被复用。任何在途槽都是正确答案；要等得更短就得维护退休顺序，而这条路径只有超界的调用才会到达，不值得为它记账。

新建槽（第二档）则藏着三个容易忽略的工程细节，作者各写了一段注释：

1. **一起提交**：`tensor` 与 `release` 事件先建进局部，最后一起 `push_back`。若半成品进了池（张量有了、事件还是 null），这个槽会被发出、然后在 null 事件上炸掉，**永久**报废。
2. **`at::empty` 而非 `empty_like`**：`empty_like` 会复制输入的布局——一个跨步输入会得到一个跨步的暂存缓冲，而传输层把暂存缓冲当**密集**的读。
3. **`InferenceMode(false)`**：暂存缓冲寿命跨调用。若某次调用恰好在用户的 `torch.inference_mode()` 里发生，缓冲就成了永远的推理张量；此后所有在推理模式之外的 `copy_` 都 raise——**一次**这样的调用就永久报废这个 (shape, dtype)。显式包一层 `InferenceMode(false)` 保证缓冲永远是普通张量。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

三档分支的完整判定（`slot` 为扫描结果）：

```text
if slot == nil 且 pool.size() < 4:        # 第二档：新建
    InferenceMode no_inference(false)     # 永远普通张量
    fresh = make_unique<Staging>()
    staged  = at::empty(x.sizes(), x.options())      # 密集，不用 empty_like
    cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&release, DisableTiming)
    fresh->tensor = staged; fresh->release = release # 局部建好
    pool.push_back(move(fresh))                      # 一起提交
    slot = pool.back().get()
elif slot == nil:                         # 第三档：池满等待
    slot = pool.front()
    cudaStreamWaitEvent(caller, slot->release, 0)    # GPU 侧，caller 流
# else: 第一档，扫描已复用
```

池的增长序列因此完全确定：同形状的第 1–4 个**互不等待的**调用依次新建 4 个槽；第 5 个等待。这正是 correctness.py 断言 `[1, 2, 3, 4, 4]` 的来源（`staging_slots_debug` 读的是池的**大小**，第 5 次不再增长）。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么池满的等待要插在 caller 流而不是 comm 流？

**答案**：插在 comm 流会拖住**所有**在途交换（包括别的形状的），并倒置依赖方向——comm 流本该只等「数据就绪」。插在 caller 流，代价只是这一次调用的暂存拷贝晚点发生，影响局限在发起者自己身上；这也和同步语义一致：caller 流本来就是被 `copy_` 占用的那条流。

**练习 2**：把 `kMaxStagingPerShape` 从 4 改成 1，功能上还正确吗？性能上会发生什么？

**答案**：正确——头文件注释明说「Sharing a slot is still correct, just not concurrent」。性能上，同形状的第二个并发调用的 `copy_` 会立刻落到等待档，caller 流被上一个交换拖住，异步形式「提前发行以重叠计算」的目的落空；q/k/v 拆分场景退化成串行。

**练习 3**：若删掉 `const c10::InferenceMode no_inference(false);`，怎样一个用户脚本会触发故障？

**答案**：用户在 `with torch.inference_mode():` 里发出某形状的第一次异步调用——暂存缓冲被建成推理张量。此后任何一次该形状的异步调用（不在推理模式中）执行 `slot->tensor.copy_(x)` 时 raise：「Inplace update to inference tensor outside InferenceMode is not allowed」。这个 (shape, dtype) 的池条目永久不可用。

### 4.4 noexcept 释放：release_staging 与 StagingRelease scope guard

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

释放只有一行语义：**在 comm 流上记录 release 事件**，声明「comm 对这个槽的读取到此为止，caller 流可以覆写了」。难点不在动作，在**时机与异常安全**：

- `run_staged` 里，`stage()` 之后的一切（prepare 校验、屏障、CE 传输）都可能抛异常。若释放只在「正常返回」路径上做，一次抛异常的调用就留下一个**从未记录** release 事件的槽。
- 从未记录的事件，`cudaEventQuery` 恒返回 `cudaSuccess`——下一次同形状调用会**毫不犹豫地复用这个槽**，在 caller 流上 `copy_` 覆写它，而 comm 流可能还在读。注释把这叫「silently, because waiting on an unrecorded event succeeds and does nothing」（[src/bindings.cc:176-179](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L176-L179)）：静默的数据竞争，不报错。
- 修法是 scope guard：`StagingRelease` 的析构函数调用 `release_staging`。C++ 栈对象在异常展开时同样析构，所以**无论 run() 正常返回还是抛出**，释放事件都会被记录。记录在 comm 流**当前尾部**——若异常发生在传输已发行之后，事件恰好排在读完之后；若异常发生得更早（比如 prepare 就拒了），事件排在 comm 已有工作之后，只是让槽「晚点被认为空闲」，保守而正确。

`release_staging` 被标 `noexcept`、且那一行 `cudaEventRecord` 刻意**不加检查宏**，两条理由都在头文件注释里（[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:130-135](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L130-L135)）：它运行在异常传播途中，析构路径上再抛（`noexcept` 下即 `std::terminate`）会把原异常吞掉换成一个更糟的崩溃；且「检查失败所能报告的状态，与不检查留下的状态完全相同」——record 失败时槽同样处于「未记录」，与什么都不做无异，检查没有收益。

顺带一提收尾路径：`destroy()`（[src/group.cc:466-473](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L466-L473)）销毁每个槽的 release 事件（同样不加检查——teardown 不抛），然后清空整张 `staging_`；Python 侧 `destroy()` 在此之前已 `comm_stream.synchronize()`（u7-l1），所以销毁事件时 comm 流已无在途读取。`run_staged` 把 `check_alive` 放在 `stage()` 之前（[src/bindings.cc:374-380](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L374-L380)），堵的正是「destroy 之后再建池条目、事件随 group 泄漏」这个缝。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
run_staged:
    检查（check_alive / require_cuda / require_group_device）
    comm = 当前流（Python 已设为 comm 流）；caller = unpack3(两整数)
    slot = group->stage(x, caller, comm)
    StagingRelease release{group, slot, comm}      # 构造 guard
    run(...)                                       # 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out
        │
        ├─ 正常返回 ──► release 析构 ──► cudaEventRecord(slot->release, comm)
        └─ 中途抛出 ──► 栈展开 ──────► release 析构 ──► 同样记录 ◄── 关键
    （异常继续向上传播；槽状态一致，不会变成「永不空闲」的假空闲）
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

scope guard 全文：[src/bindings.cc:176-191](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L176-L191)。注意注释里的另一句：「The slot this call used, not "the last one staged"」——guard 携带的是**本次调用实际用到的**槽指针；同形状多个调用在途时，各自的 guard 释放各自的槽，绝不能引用「最近一次 stage 的那个」。

释放函数本体：[src/group.cc:406-416](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L406-L416)：

```cpp
void UlyssesGroup::release_staging(Staging* slot, cudaStream_t comm) noexcept
{
    if (slot != nullptr) {
        cudaEventRecord(slot->release, comm);   // 刻意不加 ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK
    }
}
```

guard 在 `run_staged` 中的落点：[src/bindings.cc:393-395](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L393-L395)——`stage()` 返回后**立即**构造，先于 `run()` 的任何屏障。这保证保护的覆盖面是「传输全段」，而不是「传输的尾部」。

- 异步输入必须先在 **caller 流**上拷进 group 持有的暂存缓冲：直接跨流读要么内存不安全，要么用 `record_stream` 把每个已释放输入钉到 comm 流追上为止；暂存把钉住的对象换成一小池 group 自己的缓冲，还顺带吸收非连续输入。

# 暂存池：stage 与 release_staged

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u7-l1）我们看到 `all_to_all_4d_async` 把整段「屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out」流水线搬上组级 comm 流，与 caller 流上的计算重叠。但那里有一个被一笔带过的关键步骤：**输入在进入 comm 流之前，先被拷进了一块由 group 持有的暂存（staging）缓冲**。本讲回答三个问题：

1. 为什么输入必须先拷一份？直接让 comm 流读调用者的张量行不行？（答案：行，但代价是跨流生命周期问题——要么内存不安全，要么用 `record_stream` 把每个已释放的输入都钉到 comm 流追上为止。）
2. 暂存缓冲为什么是**按 (shape, dtype) 键的池**，每形状至多 4 槽、全局至多 16 个形状？第 5 个同形状并发调用会发生什么？
3. 释放事件（release event）为什么由一个 `noexcept` 函数记录，而且**在传输抛异常时也必须记录**？

学完本讲，你应该能独立读通 `stage()` 与 `release_staging()` 的每一个分支，并设计出验证池行为的测试。

## 2. 前置知识

- **caller 流与 comm 流**：u7-l1 已建立的两条互不排序的 CUDA 流。caller 流是用户代码当前所在的流（输入张量在这里产生、也在这里被读）；comm 流是 group 在构造时创建的最高优先级流（[python/fast_ulysses/group.py:94-95](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L94-L95)），异步交换全在这里执行。
- **CUDA 缓存分配器与 `record_stream`**：torch 的 GPU 内存不是每个 `free` 都真正还给驱动，而是回到 per-stream 的缓存池，**在同一条流上**复用。若一个张量在 A 流分配、又被 B 流使用，就必须调 `Tensor.record_stream(B)`，告诉分配器「B 还在用这块内存，A 流上释放后别急着复用」。代价：这块内存会被一直钉住，直到 B 流推进到登记点之后。本讲的核心权衡正是「对每个输入张量做 `record_stream`」与「拷进一小池 group 自己的缓冲」之间的选择。
- **CUDA 事件的三个操作**：`cudaEventRecord(ev, stream)` 在流的当前位置插一个完成标记；`cudaEventQuery(ev)` 立即返回 `cudaSuccess`（已触发）或 `cudaErrorNotReady`（尚未触发），不阻塞；`cudaStreamWaitEvent(s, ev, 0)` 让流 s 在 ev 触发前不再前进，也是 GPU 侧的等待、不阻塞主机。一个从未被 record 过的事件，query 会返回 `cudaSuccess`——这在后文的扫描逻辑里正好是「从未被读过」的正确答案。
- **InferenceMode（推理模式）**：`torch.inference_mode()` 下创建的张量叫**推理张量**，它不记录版本计数器，且这个身份是**永久的**——之后在推理模式之外向它做 `copy_` 会直接 raise。这是 C++ 侧一个容易踩的坑，本讲会看到 `stage()` 如何显式绕开。
- **scope guard（作用域守卫）**：一个析构函数里做清理工作的栈对象。C++ 的栈对象在离开作用域时析构，**即使是因为异常展开（exception unwinding）离开**——这是「异常路径也要释放」的标准手段。
- 承接 u6-l2 的纪律：**一切可能抛错的检查先于第一个屏障**。本讲会看到它在异步路径上的又一处应用（检查先于 `stage()`）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

注意一个分层事实：**staging 缓冲不是对称内存**。对称内存（u4 系列讲的窗口）是 peers 直写的输出通道；staging 只是普通 `at::empty` 分配的**输入副本**，从不上跨进程——它是纯粹的流间隔离装置。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 stage 拷贝与事件：为什么输入必须先拷一份

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

设想不拷贝：`all_to_all_4d_async(x)` 直接把 `x.data_ptr()` 交给 comm 流上的 CE 拷贝。有两个问题。

**问题一（内存安全）**：`x` 是 caller 流上的张量。Python 侧 `all_to_all_4d_async` 返回后，用户可能立刻让 `x` 离开作用域——分配器看到 caller 流上已无引用，就把这块内存放回缓存池，**在同一条 caller 流上**复用。而 comm 流上的交换可能还没开始读它。两条流互不排序，复用写入与交换读取就会竞争。

**问题二（`record_stream` 的代价）**：正统修法是对 `x` 调 `record_stream(comm)`——分配器从此不敢复用这块内存，直到 comm 流推进过登记点。安全了，但**每个**异步输入都被钉住一段不可控的时间；对推理循环里每步一批新输入的形态，钉住的内存量随发行节奏累积。源码注释原话：「record_stream would instead pin every freed input until the comm stream caught up」（[src/bindings.cc:389-392](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L389-L392)）。

`stage()` 选第三条路：**在 caller 流上**把 `x` 拷进一块 group 自己持有、永不提前释放的缓冲；comm 流从头到尾只看这块副本。caller 的张量只被 caller 流读，comm 的读取对象生命周期由 group 管理。一次拷贝换来两条流之间唯一的耦合点——两个事件。

附带一个红利：这个拷贝**顺便吸收了非连续输入**。`run_staged` 刻意不调 `contiguous()`——那会把重排拷贝发射到 comm 流上，恰恰变成一次「没人排序过的跨流读取」；`stage()` 里的 `copy_` 在 caller 流上做同样的事，且时序正确。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次异步调用中，staging 相关的时序（`ready` 是每次调用新建的事件；`release` 是随槽位存活的事件）：

```text
caller 流:  ... 生产 x ...
            slot->tensor.copy_(x)          ← stage() 发起的暂存拷贝
            cudaEventRecord(ready, caller)
comm  流:   cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready)   ← 副本就绪前不开读
            开路屏障 → CE 传输（读 slot->tensor）→ 收尾屏障 → copy_out
            cudaEventRecord(slot->release, comm)  ← release_staging() 记录：
                                                    comm 已读完，槽可复用
（之后某次同形状调用）
caller 流:  cudaEventQuery(slot->release) == cudaSuccess ?
            → 是：直接复用该槽          ← 零成本路径
```

两个事件各管一个方向：`ready` 让 **comm 等 caller**（副本写完才能读）；`release` 让 **caller 等 comm**（comm 读完才能覆写）。二者合起来把「一条流上的写入」安全地移交给「另一条流上的读取」，再把缓冲安全地拿回来。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看唯一调用方 `run_staged`，确认 stage 落在哪一步之前：

[src/bindings.cc:374-395](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L374-L395)：`run_staged` 的主体。按顺序：`check_alive` / `require_cuda` / `require_group_device` 三个检查**先于** `stage()`——注释给出两个理由：destroy 之后再建的 staging 条目永远不会被清理、事件随 group 泄漏；而且暂存缓冲按 (shape, dtype) 缓存却取**输入的设备**，一次错设备的调用会在错误设备上留下缓冲。随后 `comm = getCurrentCUDAStream()`（Python 已把 comm 流设为当前流），再从两个整数重建 caller 流（u7-l1 讲过的 `Stream::unpack3`），最后 `stage(input, caller, comm)`，返回的 `slot->tensor` 作为传输输入传给 `run()`。

stage 的拷贝与 ready 事件本体在 `stage()` 尾部：

[src/group.cc:340-401](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L340-L401)：`const c10::cuda::CUDAStreamGuard guard(caller);` 之后的一切都发生在 **caller 的流**上——注释明确写着「caller 的张量只在这里被读，comm 流只看到暂存副本」。尾部三行是本模块的核心：

```cpp
slot->tensor.copy_(x);                        // 暂存拷贝，caller 流
const Event ready(cudaEventDisableTiming);    // 每次调用新建，RAII 托管
ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(ready, caller));
ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready, 0));
```

注意 ready 事件「trailing everything already submitted on the caller's stream—including any earlier consumer of this same buffer」：它排在 caller 流当前尾部，所以连**同槽上一位读者的残留工作**也被一并覆盖进等待里。

`Event` 是 [include/fast_ulysses/common.hpp:33-57](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/common.hpp#L33-L57) 的 RAII 包装，在 `stage()` 返回时析构。此时它已被 record 且 comm 已挂上等待；CUDA 对「已完成记录、尚有等待挂着」的事件的销毁是延迟到引用全部完成的，所以提前销毁句柄是安全的——这也是作者用手写 `cudaEventCreateWithFlags`/`cudaEventDestroy` 配对换成 RAII 的原因之一（见该类注释：手工配对在抛异常的调用上每次泄漏一个事件）。

最后看非连续输入的实测：[test/distributed/correctness.py:167-177](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/distributed/correctness.py#L167-L177)：构造一个 `wide[..., :128]` 的跨步张量，断言它确实非连续（「built a contiguous tensor; it tests nothing」——测试自己的负控制），然后验证 async 结果与 sync 参照位精确一致。这个用例存在的原因就是 4.1.1 说的「暂存拷贝吸收跨步读取」。

**练习 2**：ready 事件为什么每次调用新建（RAII），而 release 事件随槽位常驻？

**答案**：ready 的语义是「caller 流**当前尾部**已到」——每次调用尾部不同，事件必须新鲜；用完即弃，交给 RAII 最省事。release 的语义是「comm 流已读完**这个槽**」——它描述的是槽位状态而非某次调用，要与槽同生命周期，供后续所有同形状调用 query。

### 4.2 按 (shape, dtype) 的池：结构、扫描复用与 16 形状上限

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

有了单个暂存缓冲，最朴素的实现是「一个 shape 一个槽」。但头文件注释点出要害（[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:121-126](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L121-L126)）：**共享一个槽仍然是正确的，只是不并发**——第二个调用的暂存拷贝会在 caller 流上等第一个交换退休，把「提前发行以重叠的计算」重新串行化。池存在的理由是**并发**而非正确性：把一次打包交换拆成 q/k/v 三次同形状异步调用时（这正是 lend 轮转选 4 的同一动机），三次应当同时在天上。

于是结构是：`staging_` 是一个 map，键 `(shape 向量, dtype)`，值是**槽位池**（`unique_ptr<Staging>` 的向量）。选择逻辑三档（详见 4.3 的分支图）：扫到一个 comm 流已读完的槽就复用；没有且未到上限就新建；没有且到上限就等待。

两个结构性细节值得先记：

- **`unique_ptr` 而非值存储**：调用方（`run_staged`）在整段传输期间持有裸 `Staging*`；若向量按值存 `Staging`，`push_back` 扩容会搬移对象、使已发出去的指针悬空。`unique_ptr` 保证指向的对象永不动。
- **16 形状上限**：与 `plans_` 的 512 条上限同一动机（防数据依赖形状无限增长），但这里每个条目钉着**真金白银的显存**（每形状最多 4 个整输入大小的缓冲），所以界更紧。超界时的动作是「全清」：先 `cudaEventSynchronize` 每个槽的 release 事件（**主机阻塞**，等 comm 流确实读完），销毁事件，然后 `staging_.clear()`。注释解释了为什么此时同步是安全的：`release_staging()` 在 `run_staged` 的 scope guard 里已经对**每个**已发行调用执行过，同步等到的必然是已记录的事件。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
stage(x, caller, comm):
  key = (x.shape, x.dtype)
  若 staging_ 已有 16 个形状且 key 不在其中:
      对每个槽: cudaEventSynchronize(release); cudaEventDestroy(release)   # 主机阻塞
      staging_.clear()                                # 全清，下次调用重建
  pool = staging_[key]

  CUDAStreamGuard(caller)                              # 以下全在 caller 流

  slot = null
  for candidate in pool:                               # 第一档：扫描复用
      if cudaEventQuery(candidate->release) == cudaSuccess:
          slot = candidate; break                      # comm 已读完，白拿
      （NotReady 落进 sticky last error，需 cudaGetLastError() 清掉）

  if slot == null and pool.size() < 4:                 # 第二档：新建（见 4.3）
      ...
  elif slot == null:                                   # 第三档：池满等待（见 4.3）
      ...

  slot->tensor.copy_(x)                                # caller 流
  record(ready, caller); wait(comm, ready)             # comm 等副本
  return slot
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

池的声明与注释：[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:197-199](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L197-L199)——`std::map<std::pair<std::vector<int64_t>, at::ScalarType>, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Staging>>> staging_;`，注释即「unique_ptr 因为调用方跨传输持有 `Staging*`，池增长不得搬移已发出去的槽」。

键与 16 形状上限：[src/group.cc:322-338](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L322-L338)。这段的注释把与 `plans_` 的差别讲得很清楚：「Unlike plans_, every entry here pins up to kMaxStagingPerShape inputs' worth of device memory, so the bound matters more」——plan 缓存超界清空的代价是每形状几微秒的重算，这里超界清空的代价是每个存活形状多付一次拷贝。

扫描循环：[src/group.cc:347-361](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L347-L361)：

```cpp
for (auto& candidate : pool) {
    const cudaError_t status = cudaEventQuery(candidate->release);
    if (status == cudaSuccess) { slot = candidate.get(); break; }
    if (status != cudaErrorNotReady) { ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(status); }
    (void)cudaGetLastError();
}
```

三处细节：`cudaSuccess` 即「comm 已读完（或从未记录过——从未被读，同样是空闲的正确答案）」；真正的错误码仍走检查宏抛出；而 `cudaErrorNotReady` 虽是本次调用的正常答案，却会落进 CUDA 的 sticky last error，被下一个不相关的 `cudaGetLastError()` 当成自己的错报出来——所以当场清掉，注释说这与 `at::cuda::CUDAEvent::query()` 的做法同源。

### 4.3 kMaxStagingPerShape：每形状 4 槽上限、池满等待与新建槽的三个细节

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

常量在 [include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:191-195](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L191-L195)：`static constexpr size_t kMaxStagingPerShape = 4;`。选 4 的理由写在注释里：一次打包交换拆成 q/k/v 后还有余量；而**每个槽都钉着一份完整输入的显存**，过了界就让调用等待而不是无限增长——所以 16 形状的总账是 16 × 4 = 64 个输入大小的缓冲，显存开销有硬上界。

第 5 个并发调用走「池满等待」档：挑 `pool.front()`，在 **caller 流**上 `cudaStreamWaitEvent(caller, slot->release, 0)`。两个微妙点：

- 等待插在 caller 流上，意味着这次调用的暂存拷贝 `copy_` 被推迟到 comm 流读完 front 槽——阻塞是 GPU 侧的、且阻塞的是**发起调用这条流**，不是主机。这与头文件注释「the second call's copy waits, ON THE CALLER'S STREAM」精确对应：等待的位置本身就是损失（caller 流被拖住），但方向正确（不能让 comm 流等 caller 的拷贝，那会反噬所有在途交换）。
- 挑 `front()` 而非「最先退休的槽」：注释承认 front 是「第一个**建成**的槽，不是第一个会退休的」——扫描从它开始，所以它反而最常被复用。任何在途槽都是正确答案；要等得更短就得维护退休顺序，而这条路径只有超界的调用才会到达，不值得为它记账。

新建槽（第二档）则藏着三个容易忽略的工程细节，作者各写了一段注释：

1. **一起提交**：`tensor` 与 `release` 事件先建进局部，最后一起 `push_back`。若半成品进了池（张量有了、事件还是 null），这个槽会被发出、然后在 null 事件上炸掉，**永久**报废。
2. **`at::empty` 而非 `empty_like`**：`empty_like` 会复制输入的布局——一个跨步输入会得到一个跨步的暂存缓冲，而传输层把暂存缓冲当**密集**的读。
3. **`InferenceMode(false)`**：暂存缓冲寿命跨调用。若某次调用恰好在用户的 `torch.inference_mode()` 里发生，缓冲就成了永远的推理张量；此后所有在推理模式之外的 `copy_` 都 raise——**一次**这样的调用就永久报废这个 (shape, dtype)。显式包一层 `InferenceMode(false)` 保证缓冲永远是普通张量。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

三档分支的完整判定（`slot` 为扫描结果）：

```text
if slot == nil 且 pool.size() < 4:        # 第二档：新建
    InferenceMode no_inference(false)     # 永远普通张量
    fresh = make_unique<Staging>()
    staged  = at::empty(x.sizes(), x.options())      # 密集，不用 empty_like
    cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&release, DisableTiming)
    fresh->tensor = staged; fresh->release = release # 局部建好
    pool.push_back(move(fresh))                      # 一起提交
    slot = pool.back().get()
elif slot == nil:                         # 第三档：池满等待
    slot = pool.front()
    cudaStreamWaitEvent(caller, slot->release, 0)    # GPU 侧，caller 流
# else: 第一档，扫描已复用
```

池的增长序列因此完全确定：同形状的第 1–4 个**互不等待的**调用依次新建 4 个槽；第 5 个等待。这正是 correctness.py 断言 `[1, 2, 3, 4, 4]` 的来源（`staging_slots_debug` 读的是池的**大小**，第 5 次不再增长）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

常量与总账注释：[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:191-199](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L191-L199)。

新建分支：[src/group.cc:363-384](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L363-L384)，三段注释分别对应上面三个细节，关键三行：

```cpp
const c10::InferenceMode no_inference(false);
auto        fresh   = std::make_unique<Staging>();
at::Tensor  staged  = at::empty(x.sizes(), x.options());
ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&release, cudaEventDisableTiming));
```

事件带 `cudaEventDisableTiming`：release 事件只用于「到了没有」的询问与等待，不需要时间戳，关掉计时让运行时可以选更便宜的实现（对比 u6-l2 里 `_timed` 算子的事件**必须**保留计时）。

池满分支：[src/group.cc:385-393](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L385-L393)。

实测：[test/distributed/correctness.py:191-218](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/distributed/correctness.py#L191-L218)。这个测试是三档逻辑的完整端到端验证，三处设计值得精读：

- 用**专属形状**（`packed = [torch.randn(B, 8, 4*ws, 64, ...)]`），让计数从零开始而不是接续前面的调用；
- `torch.cuda.synchronize()` 后 `torch.cuda._sleep(100_000_000)`：睡眠内核**占住 caller 流**，comm 流又等 caller 流的 ready 事件，于是五个交换发行期间没有任何一个能退休——这是逼出第二、三档的前提。注释警告：若增长序列早早出现重复（如 `[1, 1, ...]`），说明调用根本没有并发，是一次「盲跑」（blind run）而非通过；
- 断言 `growth == [1, 2, 3, 4, 4]`：前四个依次新建，第五个停在 4——正是「等待而非增长」的那一档。

另外，[docs/benchmark.md:7-11](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/benchmark.md#L7-L11) 明确：0.2.1 加入的暂存池只有正确性测试、**没有性能数字**（方法学要求整台空闲节点，当时不可得）。读任何「池带来 X% 提升」的说法都要记得这一点。

4. **解释**为什么第五次调用 `staging_slots_debug` 返回 4 而不是 5（它读 `pool.size()`，即 [src/group.cc:418-422](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L418-L422) 的 `it->second.size()`，池满后不再 push）。

**需要观察的现象**：有睡眠时 `[1, 2, 3, 4, 4]`；无睡眠时序列含重复且总槽数可能停在 1。

**预期结果**：第 5 个调用走第三档——`slot = pool.front()`，`cudaStreamWaitEvent(caller, slot->release, 0)`，**等待插在 caller 流上**（GPU 侧），随后的 `copy_` 被推迟到 comm 流读完 front 槽；主机不阻塞。多卡下的完整验证待本地验证。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么池满的等待要插在 caller 流而不是 comm 流？

**答案**：插在 comm 流会拖住**所有**在途交换（包括别的形状的），并倒置依赖方向——comm 流本该只等「数据就绪」。插在 caller 流，代价只是这一次调用的暂存拷贝晚点发生，影响局限在发起者自己身上；这也和同步语义一致：caller 流本来就是被 `copy_` 占用的那条流。

**练习 2**：把 `kMaxStagingPerShape` 从 4 改成 1，功能上还正确吗？性能上会发生什么？

**答案**：正确——头文件注释明说「Sharing a slot is still correct, just not concurrent」。性能上，同形状的第二个并发调用的 `copy_` 会立刻落到等待档，caller 流被上一个交换拖住，异步形式「提前发行以重叠计算」的目的落空；q/k/v 拆分场景退化成串行。

**练习 3**：若删掉 `const c10::InferenceMode no_inference(false);`，怎样一个用户脚本会触发故障？

**答案**：用户在 `with torch.inference_mode():` 里发出某形状的第一次异步调用——暂存缓冲被建成推理张量。此后任何一次该形状的异步调用（不在推理模式中）执行 `slot->tensor.copy_(x)` 时 raise：「Inplace update to inference tensor outside InferenceMode is not allowed」。这个 (shape, dtype) 的池条目永久不可用。

### 4.4 noexcept 释放：release_staging 与 StagingRelease scope guard

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

释放只有一行语义：**在 comm 流上记录 release 事件**，声明「comm 对这个槽的读取到此为止，caller 流可以覆写了」。难点不在动作，在**时机与异常安全**：

- `run_staged` 里，`stage()` 之后的一切（prepare 校验、屏障、CE 传输）都可能抛异常。若释放只在「正常返回」路径上做，一次抛异常的调用就留下一个**从未记录** release 事件的槽。
- 从未记录的事件，`cudaEventQuery` 恒返回 `cudaSuccess`——下一次同形状调用会**毫不犹豫地复用这个槽**，在 caller 流上 `copy_` 覆写它，而 comm 流可能还在读。注释把这叫「silently, because waiting on an unrecorded event succeeds and does nothing」（[src/bindings.cc:176-179](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L176-L179)）：静默的数据竞争，不报错。
- 修法是 scope guard：`StagingRelease` 的析构函数调用 `release_staging`。C++ 栈对象在异常展开时同样析构，所以**无论 run() 正常返回还是抛出**，释放事件都会被记录。记录在 comm 流**当前尾部**——若异常发生在传输已发行之后，事件恰好排在读完之后；若异常发生得更早（比如 prepare 就拒了），事件排在 comm 已有工作之后，只是让槽「晚点被认为空闲」，保守而正确。

`release_staging` 被标 `noexcept`、且那一行 `cudaEventRecord` 刻意**不加检查宏**，两条理由都在头文件注释里（[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:130-135](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L130-L135)）：它运行在异常传播途中，析构路径上再抛（`noexcept` 下即 `std::terminate`）会把原异常吞掉换成一个更糟的崩溃；且「检查失败所能报告的状态，与不检查留下的状态完全相同」——record 失败时槽同样处于「未记录」，与什么都不做无异，检查没有收益。

顺带一提收尾路径：`destroy()`（[src/group.cc:466-473](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L466-L473)）销毁每个槽的 release 事件（同样不加检查——teardown 不抛），然后清空整张 `staging_`；Python 侧 `destroy()` 在此之前已 `comm_stream.synchronize()`（u7-l1），所以销毁事件时 comm 流已无在途读取。`run_staged` 把 `check_alive` 放在 `stage()` 之前（[src/bindings.cc:374-380](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L374-L380)），堵的正是「destroy 之后再建池条目、事件随 group 泄漏」这个缝。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
run_staged:
    检查（check_alive / require_cuda / require_group_device）
    comm = 当前流（Python 已设为 comm 流）；caller = unpack3(两整数)
    slot = group->stage(x, caller, comm)
    StagingRelease release{group, slot, comm}      # 构造 guard
    run(...)                                       # 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out
        │
        ├─ 正常返回 ──► release 析构 ──► cudaEventRecord(slot->release, comm)
        └─ 中途抛出 ──► 栈展开 ──────► release 析构 ──► 同样记录 ◄── 关键
    （异常继续向上传播；槽状态一致，不会变成「永不空闲」的假空闲）
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

scope guard 全文：[src/bindings.cc:176-191](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L176-L191)。注意注释里的另一句：「The slot this call used, not "the last one staged"」——guard 携带的是**本次调用实际用到的**槽指针；同形状多个调用在途时，各自的 guard 释放各自的槽，绝不能引用「最近一次 stage 的那个」。

释放函数本体：[src/group.cc:406-416](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L406-L416)：

```cpp
void UlyssesGroup::release_staging(Staging* slot, cudaStream_t comm) noexcept
{
    if (slot != nullptr) {
        cudaEventRecord(slot->release, comm);   // 刻意不加 ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK
    }
}
```

guard 在 `run_staged` 中的落点：[src/bindings.cc:393-395](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L393-L395)——`stage()` 返回后**立即**构造，先于 `run()` 的任何屏障。这保证保护的覆盖面是「传输全段」，而不是「传输的尾部」。

测试探针的注册与存在理由：[src/bindings.cc:692-698](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L692-L698)——`staging_slots_debug` 的注释说得直白：多个同形状异步调用并发「正是暂存池存在的理由，而结果本身看不见它——共享一个槽也是**正确的**，只是在 caller 流上串行化。槽的数量把两者分开」。这是继 `epoch_debug` 之后第二个「结果证明不了、只能靠观测内部状态」的测试方法（u6-l1 的主题在此复现）。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：把「异常路径也必须记录释放事件」的论证写成自己的话，并找出代码里每一处为此服务的细节。

## 6. 本讲小结

- 异步输入必须先在 **caller 流**上拷进 group 持有的暂存缓冲：直接跨流读要么内存不安全，要么用 `record_stream` 把每个已释放输入钉到 comm 流追上为止；暂存把钉住的对象换成一小池 group 自己的缓冲，还顺带吸收非连续输入。
- 两个事件夹住一次交接：**ready**（每次调用新建）让 comm 等副本写完；**release**（随槽常驻）在 comm 流上声明读完。复用槽 = 查询 release 已触发，零成本。
- 池按 **(shape, dtype)** 键组织，选择三档：扫描复用 → 未达 `kMaxStagingPerShape = 4` 新建 → 池满在 **caller 流**上等 `pool.front()` 的 release（GPU 侧、不阻塞主机）；`staging_` 另有 16 形状上限，超界同步并全清。共享一个槽依然正确，池买的是**并发**。
- 新建槽的三个防御：局部建好一起提交（不留半成品）、`at::empty` 而非 `empty_like`（暂存必须密集）、`InferenceMode(false)`（防缓冲永久变成推理张量）。
- 释放由 **`StagingRelease` scope guard** 驱动：异常展开时析构同样执行，`release_staging` 是 `noexcept` 且不加检查——否则一次传输异常会留下「从未记录 release」的槽，被下次调用当空闲复用，覆写与读取静默竞争。
- 池行为**结果不可见**，`staging_slots_debug` 是唯一探针；官方正确性测试断言增长序列 `[1, 2, 3, 4, 4]`，且性能数字尚无公开测量。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- 下一讲 **u7-l3 工作注册表：StreamEventWork 与完成事件**：离开输入侧，看输出如何把 comm 流的完成事件绑到张量的 storage（`c10d::register_work`）、`wait()` 如何只在当前流插入依赖，以及无注册表时的 `CompletedHandle` 退化——与 `stage()` 的 ready/release 事件对照，你会看到同一套事件原语的另一种用法。
- 想巩固「结果证明不了、需要探针」的方法论，回头读 u6-l1 的 `epoch_debug` 一节，与本讲 `staging_slots_debug` 对比。

# 暂存池：stage 与 release_staged

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u7-l1）我们看到 `all_to_all_4d_async` 把整段「屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out」流水线搬上组级 comm 流，与 caller 流上的计算重叠。但那里有一个被一笔带过的关键步骤：**输入在进入 comm 流之前，先被拷进了一块由 group 持有的暂存（staging）缓冲**。本讲回答三个问题：

1. 为什么输入必须先拷一份？直接让 comm 流读调用者的张量行不行？（答案：行，但代价是跨流生命周期问题——要么内存不安全，要么用 `record_stream` 把每个已释放的输入都钉到 comm 流追上为止。）
2. 暂存缓冲为什么是**按 (shape, dtype) 键的池**，每形状至多 4 槽、全局至多 16 个形状？第 5 个同形状并发调用会发生什么？
3. 释放事件（release event）为什么由一个 `noexcept` 函数记录，而且**在传输抛异常时也必须记录**？

学完本讲，你应该能独立读通 `stage()` 与 `release_staging()` 的每一个分支，并设计出验证池行为的测试。

## 2. 前置知识

- **caller 流与 comm 流**：u7-l1 已建立的两条互不排序的 CUDA 流。caller 流是用户代码当前所在的流（输入张量在这里产生、也在这里被读）；comm 流是 group 在构造时创建的最高优先级流（[python/fast_ulysses/group.py:94-95](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L94-L95)），异步交换全在这里执行。
- **CUDA 缓存分配器与 `record_stream`**：torch 的 GPU 内存不是每个 `free` 都真正还给驱动，而是回到 per-stream 的缓存池，**在同一条流上**复用。若一个张量在 A 流分配、又被 B 流使用，就必须调 `Tensor.record_stream(B)`，告诉分配器「B 还在用这块内存，A 流上释放后别急着复用」。代价：这块内存会被一直钉住，直到 B 流推进到登记点之后。本讲的核心权衡正是「对每个输入张量做 `record_stream`」与「拷进一小池 group 自己的缓冲」之间的选择。
- **CUDA 事件的三个操作**：`cudaEventRecord(ev, stream)` 在流的当前位置插一个完成标记；`cudaEventQuery(ev)` 立即返回 `cudaSuccess`（已触发）或 `cudaErrorNotReady`（尚未触发），不阻塞；`cudaStreamWaitEvent(s, ev, 0)` 让流 s 在 ev 触发前不再前进，也是 GPU 侧的等待、不阻塞主机。一个从未被 record 过的事件，query 会返回 `cudaSuccess`——这在后文的扫描逻辑里正好是「从未被读过」的正确答案。
- **InferenceMode（推理模式）**：`torch.inference_mode()` 下创建的张量叫**推理张量**，它不记录版本计数器，且这个身份是**永久的**——之后在推理模式之外向它做 `copy_` 会直接 raise。这是 C++ 侧一个容易踩的坑，本讲会看到 `stage()` 如何显式绕开。
- **scope guard（作用域守卫）**：一个析构函数里做清理工作的栈对象。C++ 的栈对象在离开作用域时析构，**即使是因为异常展开（exception unwinding）离开**——这是「异常路径也要释放」的标准手段。
- 承接 u6-l2 的纪律：**一切可能抛错的检查先于第一个屏障**。本讲会看到它在异步路径上的又一处应用（检查先于 `stage()`）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 |

注意一个分层事实：**staging 缓冲不是对称内存**。对称内存（u4 系列讲的窗口）是 peers 直写的输出通道；staging 只是普通 `at::empty` 分配的**输入副本**，从不上跨进程——它是纯粹的流间隔离装置。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 stage 拷贝与事件：为什么输入必须先拷一份

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

设想不拷贝：`all_to_all_4d_async(x)` 直接把 `x.data_ptr()` 交给 comm 流上的 CE 拷贝。有两个问题。

**问题一（内存安全）**：`x` 是 caller 流上的张量。Python 侧 `all_to_all_4d_async` 返回后，用户可能立刻让 `x` 离开作用域——分配器看到 caller 流上已无引用，就把这块内存放回缓存池，**在同一条 caller 流上**复用。而 comm 流上的交换可能还没开始读它。两条流互不排序，复用写入与交换读取就会竞争。

**问题二（`record_stream` 的代价）**：正统修法是对 `x` 调 `record_stream(comm)`——分配器从此不敢复用这块内存，直到 comm 流推进过登记点。安全了，但**每个**异步输入都被钉住一段不可控的时间；对推理循环里每步一批新输入的形态，钉住的内存量随发行节奏累积。源码注释原话：「record_stream would instead pin every freed input until the comm stream caught up」（[src/bindings.cc:389-392](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L389-L392)）。

`stage()` 选第三条路：**在 caller 流上**把 `x` 拷进一块 group 自己持有、永不提前释放的缓冲；comm 流从头到尾只看这块副本。caller 的张量只被 caller 流读，comm 的读取对象生命周期由 group 管理。一次拷贝换来两条流之间唯一的耦合点——两个事件。

附带一个红利：这个拷贝**顺便吸收了非连续输入**。`run_staged` 刻意不调 `contiguous()`——那会把重排拷贝发射到 comm 流上，恰恰变成一次「没人排序过的跨流读取」；`stage()` 里的 `copy_` 在 caller 流上做同样的事，且时序正确。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次异步调用中，staging 相关的时序（`ready` 是每次调用新建的事件；`release` 是随槽位存活的事件）：

```text
caller 流:  ... 生产 x ...
            slot->tensor.copy_(x)          ← stage() 发起的暂存拷贝
            cudaEventRecord(ready, caller)
comm  流:   cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready)   ← 副本就绪前不开读
            开路屏障 → CE 传输（读 slot->tensor）→ 收尾屏障 → copy_out
            cudaEventRecord(slot->release, comm)  ← release_staging() 记录：
                                                    comm 已读完，槽可复用
（之后某次同形状调用）
caller 流:  cudaEventQuery(slot->release) == cudaSuccess ?
            → 是：直接复用该槽          ← 零成本路径
```

两个事件各管一个方向：`ready` 让 **comm 等 caller**（副本写完才能读）；`release` 让 **caller 等 comm**（comm 读完才能覆写）。二者合起来把「一条流上的写入」安全地移交给「另一条流上的读取」，再把缓冲安全地拿回来。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看唯一调用方 `run_staged`，确认 stage 落在哪一步之前：

[src/bindings.cc:374-395](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L374-L395)：`run_staged` 的主体。按顺序：`check_alive` / `require_cuda` / `require_group_device` 三个检查**先于** `stage()`——注释给出两个理由：destroy 之后再建的 staging 条目永远不会被清理、事件随 group 泄漏；而且暂存缓冲按 (shape, dtype) 缓存却取**输入的设备**，一次错设备的调用会在错误设备上留下缓冲。随后 `comm = getCurrentCUDAStream()`（Python 已把 comm 流设为当前流），再从两个整数重建 caller 流（u7-l1 讲过的 `Stream::unpack3`），最后 `stage(input, caller, comm)`，返回的 `slot->tensor` 作为传输输入传给 `run()`。

stage 的拷贝与 ready 事件本体在 `stage()` 尾部：

[src/group.cc:340-401](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L340-L401)：`const c10::cuda::CUDAStreamGuard guard(caller);` 之后的一切都发生在 **caller 的流**上——注释明确写着「caller 的张量只在这里被读，comm 流只看到暂存副本」。尾部三行是本模块的核心：

```cpp
slot->tensor.copy_(x);                        // 暂存拷贝，caller 流
const Event ready(cudaEventDisableTiming);    // 每次调用新建，RAII 托管
ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(ready, caller));
ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready, 0));
```

注意 ready 事件「trailing everything already submitted on the caller's stream—including any earlier consumer of this same buffer」：它排在 caller 流当前尾部，所以连**同槽上一位读者的残留工作**也被一并覆盖进等待里。

`Event` 是 [include/fast_ulysses/common.hpp:33-57](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/common.hpp#L33-L57) 的 RAII 包装，在 `stage()` 返回时析构。此时它已被 record 且 comm 已挂上等待；CUDA 对「已完成记录、尚有等待挂着」的事件的销毁是延迟到引用全部完成的，所以提前销毁句柄是安全的——这也是作者用手写 `cudaEventCreateWithFlags`/`cudaEventDestroy` 配对换成 RAII 的原因之一（见该类注释：手工配对在抛异常的调用上每次泄漏一个事件）。

最后看非连续输入的实测：[test/distributed/correctness.py:167-177](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/distributed/correctness.py#L167-L177)：构造一个 `wide[..., :128]` 的跨步张量，断言它确实非连续（「built a contiguous tensor; it tests nothing」——测试自己的负控制），然后验证 async 结果与 sync 参照位精确一致。这个用例存在的原因就是 4.1.1 说的「暂存拷贝吸收跨步读取」。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果把 `cudaStreamWaitEvent(comm, ready, 0)` 这一行删掉，最坏会发生什么？

**答案**：comm 流不再等暂存拷贝完成。CE 拷贝可能在 `copy_` 写入之前或进行中读取 `slot->tensor`，读到旧数据或半新半旧的数据——静默的数据错误，不报错。特别是复用槽位时（4.2），旧一轮数据还在，错误结果看起来完全合法。

**练习 2**：ready 事件为什么每次调用新建（RAII），而 release 事件随槽位常驻？

**答案**：ready 的语义是「caller 流**当前尾部**已到」——每次调用尾部不同，事件必须新鲜；用完即弃，交给 RAII 最省事。release 的语义是「comm 流已读完**这个槽**」——它描述的是槽位状态而非某次调用，要与槽同生命周期，供后续所有同形状调用 query。

### 4.2 按 (shape, dtype) 的池：结构、扫描复用与 16 形状上限

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

有了单个暂存缓冲，最朴素的实现是「一个 shape 一个槽」。但头文件注释点出要害（[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:121-126](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L121-L126)）：**共享一个槽仍然是正确的，只是不并发**——第二个调用的暂存拷贝会在 caller 流上等第一个交换退休，把「提前发行以重叠的计算」重新串行化。池存在的理由是**并发**而非正确性：把一次打包交换拆成 q/k/v 三次同形状异步调用时（这正是 lend 轮转选 4 的同一动机），三次应当同时在天上。

于是结构是：`staging_` 是一个 map，键 `(shape 向量, dtype)`，值是**槽位池**（`unique_ptr<Staging>` 的向量）。选择逻辑三档（详见 4.3 的分支图）：扫到一个 comm 流已读完的槽就复用；没有且未到上限就新建；没有且到上限就等待。

两个结构性细节值得先记：

- **`unique_ptr` 而非值存储**：调用方（`run_staged`）在整段传输期间持有裸 `Staging*`；若向量按值存 `Staging`，`push_back` 扩容会搬移对象、使已发出去的指针悬空。`unique_ptr` 保证指向的对象永不动。
- **16 形状上限**：与 `plans_` 的 512 条上限同一动机（防数据依赖形状无限增长），但这里每个条目钉着**真金白银的显存**（每形状最多 4 个整输入大小的缓冲），所以界更紧。超界时的动作是「全清」：先 `cudaEventSynchronize` 每个槽的 release 事件（**主机阻塞**，等 comm 流确实读完），销毁事件，然后 `staging_.clear()`。注释解释了为什么此时同步是安全的：`release_staging()` 在 `run_staged` 的 scope guard 里已经对**每个**已发行调用执行过，同步等到的必然是已记录的事件。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
stage(x, caller, comm):
  key = (x.shape, x.dtype)
  若 staging_ 已有 16 个形状且 key 不在其中:
      对每个槽: cudaEventSynchronize(release); cudaEventDestroy(release)   # 主机阻塞
      staging_.clear()                                # 全清，下次调用重建
  pool = staging_[key]

  CUDAStreamGuard(caller)                              # 以下全在 caller 流

  slot = null
  for candidate in pool:                               # 第一档：扫描复用
      if cudaEventQuery(candidate->release) == cudaSuccess:
          slot = candidate; break                      # comm 已读完，白拿
      （NotReady 落进 sticky last error，需 cudaGetLastError() 清掉）

  if slot == null and pool.size() < 4:                 # 第二档：新建（见 4.3）
      ...
  elif slot == null:                                   # 第三档：池满等待（见 4.3）
      ...

  slot->tensor.copy_(x)                                # caller 流
  record(ready, caller); wait(comm, ready)             # comm 等副本
  return slot
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

池的声明与注释：[include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:197-199](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L197-L199)——`std::map<std::pair<std::vector<int64_t>, at::ScalarType>, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Staging>>> staging_;`，注释即「unique_ptr 因为调用方跨传输持有 `Staging*`，池增长不得搬移已发出去的槽」。

键与 16 形状上限：[src/group.cc:322-338](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L322-L338)。这段的注释把与 `plans_` 的差别讲得很清楚：「Unlike plans_, every entry here pins up to kMaxStagingPerShape inputs' worth of device memory, so the bound matters more」——plan 缓存超界清空的代价是每形状几微秒的重算，这里超界清空的代价是每个存活形状多付一次拷贝。

扫描循环：[src/group.cc:347-361](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L347-L361)：

```cpp
for (auto& candidate : pool) {
    const cudaError_t status = cudaEventQuery(candidate->release);
    if (status == cudaSuccess) { slot = candidate.get(); break; }
    if (status != cudaErrorNotReady) { ULYSSES_CUDA_CHECK(status); }
    (void)cudaGetLastError();
}
```

三处细节：`cudaSuccess` 即「comm 已读完（或从未记录过——从未被读，同样是空闲的正确答案）」；真正的错误码仍走检查宏抛出；而 `cudaErrorNotReady` 虽是本次调用的正常答案，却会落进 CUDA 的 sticky last error，被下一个不相关的 `cudaGetLastError()` 当成自己的错报出来——所以当场清掉，注释说这与 `at::cuda::CUDAEvent::query()` 的做法同源。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习**：为什么 `staging_` 的值是 `vector<unique_ptr<Staging>>` 而不是 `vector<Staging>`？如果换成后者，哪个具体代码位置会首先出问题？

**答案**：`run_staged` 在 `stage()` 返回后一直持有 `Staging* slot`（[src/bindings.cc:393-395](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L393-L395)），并在 scope guard 里再次使用它。若按值存储，`pool.push_back(...)`（[src/group.cc:382](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L382)）引起向量扩容时对象被搬移，前一次调用还握着的指针指向已作废的内存——`release_staging(slot, comm)` 会把释放事件记到一块随机内存上。

### 4.3 kMaxStagingPerShape：每形状 4 槽上限、池满等待与新建槽的三个细节

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

常量在 [include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp:191-195](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/group.hpp#L191-L195)：`static constexpr size_t kMaxStagingPerShape = 4;`。选 4 的理由写在注释里：一次打包交换拆成 q/k/v 后还有余量；而**每个槽都钉着一份完整输入的显存**，过了界就让调用等待而不是无限增长——所以 16 形状的总账是 16 × 4 = 64 个输入大小的缓冲，显存开销有硬上界。

第 5 个并发调用走「池满等待」档：挑 `pool.front()`，在 **caller 流**上 `cudaStreamWaitEvent(caller, slot->release, 0)`。两个微妙点：

- 等待插在 caller 流上，意味着这次调用的暂存拷贝 `copy_` 被推迟到 comm 流读完 front 槽——阻塞是 GPU 侧的、且阻塞的是**发起调用这条流**，不是主机。这与头文件注释「the second call's copy waits, ON THE CALLER'S STREAM」精确对应：等待的位置本身就是损失（caller 流被拖住），但方向正确（不能让 comm 流等 caller 的拷贝，那会反噬所有在途交换）。
- 挑 `front()` 而非「最先退休的槽」：注释承认 front 是「第一个**建成**的槽，不是第一个会退休的」——扫描从它开始，所以它反而最常被复用。任何在途槽都是正确答案；要等得更短就得维护退休顺序，而这条路径只有超界的调用才会到达，不值得为它记账。

新建槽（第二档）则藏着三个容易忽略的工程细节，作者各写了一段注释：

1. **一起提交**：`tensor` 与 `release` 事件先建进局部，最后一起 `push_back`。若半成品进了池（张量有了、事件还是 null），这个槽会被发出、然后在 null 事件上炸掉，**永久**报废。
2. **`at::empty` 而非 `empty_like`**：`empty_like` 会复制输入的布局——一个跨步输入会得到一个跨步的暂存缓冲，而传输层把暂存缓冲当**密集**的读。
3. **`InferenceMode(false)`**：暂存缓冲寿命跨调用。若某次调用恰好在用户的 `torch.inference_mode()` 里发生，缓冲就成了永远的推理张量；此后所有在推理模式之外的 `copy_` 都 raise——**一次**这样的调用就永久报废这个 (shape, dtype)。显式包一层 `InferenceMode(false)` 保证缓冲永远是普通张量。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

三档分支的完整判定（`slot` 为扫描结果）：

```text
if slot == nil 且 pool.size() < 4:        # 第二档：新建
    InferenceMode no_inference(false)     # 永远普通张量
    fresh = make_unique<Staging>()
    staged  = at::empty(x.sizes(), x.options())      # 密集，不用 empty_like
    cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&release, DisableTiming)
    fresh->tensor = staged; fresh->release = release # 局部建好
    pool.push_back(move(fresh))                      # 一起提交
    slot = pool.back().get()
elif slot == nil:                         # 第三档：池满等待
    slot = pool.front()
    cudaStreamWaitEvent(caller, slot->release, 0)    # GPU 侧，caller 流
# else: 第一档，扫描已复用
```

池的增长序列因此完全确定：同形状的第 1–4 个**互不等待的**调用依次新建 4 个槽；第 5 个等待。这正是 correctness.py 断言 `[1, 2, 3, 4, 4]` 的来源（`staging_slots_debug` 读的是池的**大小**，第 5 次不再增长）。
